data.name: Dice 1000 online
data.detailed_description:
This game is a simulator of a board game. The main target of the game is to get 1000 points. A player rolls 5 bones (dice) and collects points. Look at screenshots to find out rules of the game.

The game provides:
- playing online with a computer or a real person
- regulations of the game are available inside the client ( see game official website as well )
- mouse control (except login part)
- check how lucky is your day today
- balanced rules
- Latency or ping does not influence on quality of gameplay.

- Hints:
- If your opponent has 750 and you have 0 do not be upset much, because there are 3 barrels that must to pass your opponent.




Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bonesGame.online

reviews.review:
Review Updated 31/08/18
Impeccable history of talented Russian developer…

•	19 Oct 2017 some bugs fixed because game does not work

•	22 Oct 2017 fixing those bugs of the bugs I originally thought was fixed, because the game still does not work

•	27 Oct 2017 Bloody Hell. Really getting ticked off with fixing these bugs that I keep thinking are fixed. Starting to think the bugs in my game are breeding/evolving. Concerned that there might be a Jim Sterling quality expose on me soon. Must fool customers by reaffirming that the bugs are tiny small ones and divert their attention that everything is fine by adding cup for dice. Can’t let them know game does not work.

•	19 Nov 2017 been a month now, still fixing the bugs. Beginning to tire, it’s been such a hard fight. Decided to immortalise the battle of me and the bugs by adding a sword on the table and some pirate music. Feels like I’ve been at this forever, I’m hungry, lonely and desperate. Added the ability so that two friends can play together, problem is the game still does not work. So how do you create a profound experience for two people to share with each other on a game that doesn’t actually work? I know I’ll add meat on the table so that you can stare at your partner’s meat and watch an Elton John candle flicker in the wind. 

•	11 Dec 2017 had serious problems with servers, people were not able to join up with friends and began to look at the meat of strangers. People seriously getting weirded out by a game that does not work, but forces you to look at other people’s meat.

•	28 Feb 2018 since I can’t fix the bugs, I’ve resorted to plan B. I’ve written a review about it myself and given it a thumbs up along with all my other aliases. I have also sent copies to friends and family and didn’t need to prompt them too much the need to give this game a thumbs up. It seems I’m not the only one, that gets the fact that there is a severe shortage on 'Steam' at the moment, games that don’t work, but which allow you to stare at someone else’s meat, while you play around with your cup.

•	7 March 2018 decided to confess that I will fix the bugs in a weeks’ time. I feel dirty. It’s not right their being bugs while you look at someone else’s meat. My momma and Poppa always told me, that I need better protection when I go around gaming and meat is involved.

•	14 Mar 2018 Bugs still here, game does not work. Thinking I need to add two walnuts to go with the meat for people to stare at, while I try desperately to fix...


•	27 Mar 2018 decided to start selling the game at 60% off that should make people want to buy a game that does not work. Also decided to quicken up the response time of the computer so that people don’t have to wait that long to see that it is all about staring at meat.

•	7 Jul 2018 fixed a huge bug. Well in my eyes it was huge. Game still does not work. But that is not the main thing. The main thing is that I am still at it for well over a year now working desperately to try and get this game to work. Noticed some stupid reviewer keeps on and on about my table of meats. Added a log in which will crash if you put the letter ‘V’ in it, because V is for Vegan which is evil. We are all into ‘SM’ salami meats here. If you put ‘V’ or ‘K’ or any other letter which is not meat related you will now be forced to look at a table meat free.

•	19 Aug 2018 placed 213 achievements to a game which may now work, but no one will be able to know because they can’t get passed the log in meat free screen. Think of all the meat you are missing out on…

Below a sample why the game does not work (sorry Meat free)…

https://youtu.be/5CRqc5pdsyg

If you enjoy reading this review, feel free to subscribe to one of my curator pages below…

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/GamesPlayedHard
http://store.steampowered.com/curator/6843548/
